'''Death Dealers''' the most notorious Polish QuakeWorld clan.

=== History ===
'''Death Dealers''' (D2) is a Polish QuakeWorld clan formed in [[1998]] by members of the two best Polish clans at the time being - [[Brotherhood of the Herb]] (BoH) and [[The Immortals]] (IM). 
Death Dealers was the first Polish clan known of having two separate divisions: [[LPB]] (division leaders: [[Acid (Polish Player)|Acid]]/[[Dread (Polish Player)|Dread]]) and [[HPB]] (division leader [[Plast]]). The clan was mostly inactive in [[2002]]-[[2003]], until [[Plast]]'s return and reactivation in [[2004]]. Since then D2 has participated in almost every European league, including [[NQR]] and [[EQL]], until the clan disbanded again in [[2007]].
